name: Research Core
description: Default Sci-Station research agent preset for project-aware planning, paper review, proposal drafting, library curation, and code/data review.

commands.title: Paper Review
commands.prompt_template: Review the selected paper for contribution, method, assumptions, limitations, and relevance to the current project.

commands.title: Proposal Draft
commands.prompt_template: Draft or update a modular project proposal from current project wiki, core papers, tasks, and materials.

commands.title: Experiment Plan
commands.prompt_template: Turn the current research question into tasks, code/data requirements, risks, and validation checks.

commands.title: Library Curate
commands.prompt_template: Propose reversible metadata cleanup, tags, priorities, and project links for the current paper selection.

commands.title: Code And Data Review
commands.prompt_template: Review selected code and data paths for reproducibility risks, local-only assumptions, silent failures, and validation gaps.

skills.name: agent-platform
skills.description: Sci-Station Swift-native agent platform architecture, safety, provider, tool, hook, plugin, and MCP guidance.

skills.name: research-workflow
skills.description: Sci-Station research workflows for literature review, proposal drafting, library curation, and code/data review.

hooks.additional_context: Use Sci-Station's Swift-native agent core, keep secrets out of workspace files, and preserve existing agent history.

hooks.message: Dangerous command blocked by the research-core safety preset.
If this task modified code or data, record validation or explain why validation was not run.
